completed: MPI-394 SHIPPED d76b60c8, closed e7156a14. Root cause was TWO mechanisms: renderList() wipes bodySlot and destroys every loaded preview, AND MpiTileSheet rebuilt each thumb as a lazy whose replacement has no pixels and defers its load behind a main thread pegged by _listSignature (O(n^2) _sharedOwnedDepIds per model) plus reSyncInstalledModels. Fix keeps the ELEMENTS alive: MpiTileSheet takes a consumer-owned previewCache Map, builds each thumb once per id and re-parents it. Covers EVERY rebuild path, not just install/uninstall. Plus 5 ffmpeg .webp posters by filename convention, and the uninstall toast verb. USER-VERIFIED all five acceptance items.

MPI-395 SHIPPED 7c13f354. downloadService armed its terminal listener INSIDE the post-POST .then(), but the start route calls _startPendingDeps() before res.json() and a fully-satisfied install goes terminal there - so download:complete preceded the listener, _awaitDownloadDone burned its 30-min ceiling with _inFlight pinned, and every install in that window sat at queued with no revert timer (only pending arms one). Ships to users: _installRemoteEngineAssets re-runs every session and is a no-op on a warm volume. Fixed by arming before the POST plus an explicit cancel for the unfired-POST case; ceiling now logs; engine:assets suppressed in notificationService.
rules/downloads.md gained rule 6 (arm-before-POST), with the user approving the rule-file edit.
Suite baseline is now 293/293. Both guards negative-controlled: MPI-394 0/3 unfixed to 3/3, MPI-395 1/4 to 4/4 (the one passing both ways deliberately pins the route ordering the fix rests on).
pending: MPI-395 THREE RESIDUALS - all runnable on the CPU Pod already up, NO GPU needed, and the uninstall freed ~9GB of headroom. (1) Legitimate queue: start one install, click Install on a second - it SHOULD read Queued then start when the first finishes downloading. (2) Cancel-while-queued: cancel that queued one, the chain must release. THIS IS THE ONLY PIECE OF THE FIX WITH NO LIVE COVERAGE - it exercises the new done.cancel() path. (3) Unfocused OS notification must not say engine:assets.

key_decisions: MPI-394: kept the wholesale rebuild and cached the preview ELEMENTS instead of building a keyed whole-grid diff. Section moves cross sheet INSTANCES, so an honest diff means persisting 4 sheets plus headers plus per-tile reconcile inside a Primitive shared by 3 surfaces - much larger blast radius for the same visible result.

MPI-395: REFUSED the suggestion to delete and recreate the network volume. On a fresh volume the engine-asset install becomes a real 1.76GB download that always lands after the listener is armed, so wiping would have HIDDEN the bug and lost the reproduction.
notificationService carries the engine:assets literal rather than importing it, to keep the deliberately-lazy downloadService import in shell.js out of boot; a test pins the two in sync.
The 30-minute _awaitDownloadDone ceiling was kept (legitimate backstop for a genuinely dropped signal) but now logs, converting a future wedge from invisible to greppable.
